notes: The page's feed column at rest: the first post card and the load-more control, the two boxes both clients draw. `origin` is the first card, because the page's frame and the app's frame are different heights and the page's search box and members strip are chrome the app does not draw yet (#658); the design this contract owns is the card's own box and the control under it. `capture` is the load-more control, because its words and its pill are the same on both clients and do not depend on the feed's data. The post text is data, so it is not measured; the card's height is left out for the same reason (the page's footer also carries the share and actions controls, which are not part of this slice). The search field and the search summary are anchored on the page for the slice that ports search, but they are not part of this contract: the app has no search control yet, and a contract element the app does not draw would be a number with nothing behind it.

motion.notes: Feed cards lift 6px, shift their border and background, and scale their cover to 1.05 on hover or keyboard focus over 500-700ms; the same means the same travel and easing, with reduced motion dropping the travel and scale. The load-more glyph spins while the next page is in flight.

entries.gesture: hover over or keyboard-focus a feed card
entries.moves: the card lifts 6px, shifts its border and background, and scales its cover to 1.05 over 500-700ms
entries.same: the same lift, border and background shift, cover scale and 500-700ms easing; reduced motion drops the travel and scale

entries.moves: the glyph spins while the next page is in flight
entries.same: the same spinner and in-flight state; it reports progress so it stays under reduced motion
